jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: About 1X We're building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it's not. To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you're inspired by this, you'll thrive here. We've been at this since 2014 and we're at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us. NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We're not demoing it - we're shipping it. We're excited to meet you, if this excites you. If you've spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We're scaling, we're hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all. About The Team The Cloud Infrastructure team owns the platform every other team at 1X builds on: our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, CI systems, identity and access layer, and the GPU compute our AI, robotics, and fleet teams depend on every day. We're a small team with an outsized blast radius - there's no SRE org or ticket queue between us and the engineers we serve, so when a training run needs a thousand GPUs by Monday, a cluster goes down at 2am, or a robot in someone's home needs a secure path back to our cloud, it lands with us. Your Charter The mission of this role is to make 1X's cloud infrastructure reliable, secure, and self-service enough that every team building NEO can move as fast as the hardware allows. You'll own the reliability and scalability of our cloud infrastructure end-to-end, from architecture decisions through incident response, and build the automation and self-service tooling that lets the broader engineering team handle common requests safely on their own, without piling up technical debt. You'll also be a steady hand for day-to-day urgent requests and team support when the platform needs it most. Key Outcomes Design and maintain infrastructure-as-code systems that make provisioning and scaling reliable and easy. Build self-service tooling that lets engineers safely handle common cloud requests without creating technical debt. Drive incident response with clear communication and urgency, and lead post-incident remediations so we systematically improve. Partner with the security team to strengthen cloud infrastructure security and reliability. Key Competencies Deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, and cloud architecture trade-offs. Strong infrastructure-as-code mindset. Pragmatic about balancing speed against long-term architecture. Calm, clear communicator who brings urgency to incident response. Bias toward automation and self-service tooling over manual toil. Customer-focused attitude that shows up in how you support urgent requests from the team. Minimum Requirements Proven track record of 5+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role. Experience with hands-on production operation of a major cloud provider or large-scale on-prem infrastructure using modern tooling. Experience with service-to-service communication, specifically identity and auth. Demonstrated ability to write production code in Python and/or Go. Experience with Terraform. Preferred Skills Experience in improving incident response processes. Experience with AWS, Cloudflare, and/or GPU cloud providers. Experience in infrastructure security. Experience with chaos engineering and improving cloud reliability under adverse conditions. Experience in improving CI as a platform. What does a successful 1X Team Member look like Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it's the one thing you can't get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect. Compensation Range $190,000 - $230,000 + Equity Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%) Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options Commuter benefits (transit and parking) Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support Onsite snacks and catered lunches Equal Opportunity Employer 1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Compensation Range: $190K - $230K

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Product Facing Systems (Remote)
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of our platform that supports enterprise system applications, integrations, and services. You’ll help with the entire lifecycle right from concept stage until delivery and post-launch support. The candidate will be heavily involved in driving the technology strategy, best practices, and roadmap at Abercrombie & Fitch. In this role, you’ll work cross-functionally to execute and deliver associate experiences on our Product Facing Systems. Responsibilities include operating, maintaining, and optimizing applications running on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) across multiple environments. Candidates are expected to proactively research new trends and capabilities applicable to our platform solutions, maintaining, upgrading and developing solutions to enhance our platforms and collaborating with third-party software vendors, etc. What Will You Be Doing? Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitLab, and related tools. Proactive monitoring for updates & research to stay current on emerging technologies, cloud capabilities, Kubernetes advancements, and industry best practices. Design and implement Azure platform architecture, including landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, networking, and governance. Manage, maintain, and optimize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) environments across production and non-production landscapes, including: Kubernetes resource management and application onboarding Cluster lifecycle management, upgrades, and patching SSL certificate and secret lifecycle management Service principal credential renewal and access management Build, maintain, and deploy infrastructure as code using Terraform, ensuring platforms leverage current standards and reusable modules. Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, certificate renewals, and operational workflows. Support application teams with Kubernetes deployments, troubleshooting, release management, and environment promotion strategies. Manage platform security and access controls, including RBAC, SAS tokens, Key Vault integration, and security best practices. Ensure observability, monitoring, and platform health through tools such as Splunk and Dynatrace. Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. Drive standardization across environments, including networking, security, monitoring, deployment, and operational practices. Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and production issues across all environments. Establish and enforce engineering, deployment, and operational best practices. Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, architecture diagrams, infrastructure patterns, and deployment templates. Collaborate with developers, product owners, architects, business partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable solutions and a high level of customer service. Participate in Agile ceremonies, feature planning, dependency management, and project delivery activities. Mentor and assist with onboarding team members while contributing to continuous improvement of engineering practices. Identify risks early, develop mitigation plans, and contribute to application and platform roadmaps. What Do You Need To Bring? 5+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment maintaining cloud-based technology Proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud infrastructure and platform services in Azure, including cloud migrations, governance, networking, and security. Proven track record of improving system reliability and scalability Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Bicep), and application deployment automation. Strong understanding of platform reliability, scalability, observability, and performance optimization, including monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or similar solutions. Experience defining and enforcing security standards, access controls, networking patterns, and operational best practices across enterprise environments. Familiarity with Java APIs (Spring Boot, Kafka) and React based UIs and troubleshooting techniques, including profiling and root cause analysis. Working knowledge of source control and development tools, including GitLab, Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, and Agile delivery methodologies. Proven ability to continuously improve deployment pipelines, platform capabilities, and engineering practices through automation, AI, and modern DevOps approaches. Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle, from solution design, development, testing, deployment and production support. Strong organizational, time management skills & work ethic - ability to drive to an outcome individually as well as in a team environment. Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships, influence decisions, build consensus, and work effectively across teams. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify, elevate, and mitigate technical risks. Self-starter who enjoys understanding architectural decisions, solving complex problems, and continuously learning new technologies. Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing competing priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience or excitement to leverage AI & automation tools within day-to-day practices Excitement to support onboarding and mentoring teammates to contribute to the success of the broader engineering organization. Retail and/or e-commerce experience preferred. Benefits & Perks As an Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward: Incentive bonus program 401(K) savings plan with company match Annual companywide review process Flexible spending accounts Medical, dental and vision insurance Life and disability insurance Associate assistance program Paid parental and adoption leave Access to fertility and adoption benefits through Carrot Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace Paid Caregiver Leave Mobile Stipend Paid time off and one paid volunteer day per year, allowing you to give back to your community Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles and six work from anywhere weeks per year) Seven associate wellness half days per year Merchandise discount on all of our brands Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within Access to multiple Associate Resource Groups Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU! This role allows for remote work across the U.S.. Therefore, in states and cities that require the hourly or salary compensation or pay range to be included in a job posting, the recruiting pay range for this position is $121,000 - $144,000. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, your years of experience, your work location, comparison to other employees in similar or related roles, or market demands. The range may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Generative AI Applications Engineer (Agents & RAG)
jobs.description: At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward! Build AI that matters . We ship production GenAI apps for confidential federal programs across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health where reliability, privacy, and safety aren’t optional. AFS is a technology company within global Accenture and a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work. You’ll join a collaborative, inclusive community with handson growth, certifications, and industry training. We ship in weeks, not quarters, and measure success with latency, reliability, safety, and cost. Confidentiality matters: We don’t disclose program details publicly. If you advance, we’ll share specifics during the process. Role Overview You’ll turn mission needs into secure, reliable, and scalable GenAI applications no model training required. This is a hands-on role across agentic workflows, RAG, prompt/policy design, LLM evaluation, and platform integration. You’ll own the end-to-end path from use case evaluation → production deployment → operational excellence, partnering with product, security, data, and SRE to ship features safely and at scale. What You’ll Do (Day To Day) Design & ship mission grade GenAI: Build agentic workflows and RAG systems tailored to mission data and environments; target low hallucination, tight p95 latency, and predictable cost. Agent frameworks & orchestration: Apply patterns from LangChain/LlamaIndex/Semantic Kernel; design task decomposition, tool use, guardrails, and recovery/fallback strategies. Platform integration (no model training): Implement with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Kendra, and managed services (e.g., Document AI, Gemini, Gemma). LLM selection & evaluation: Compare models for quality, safety, latency, cost; author/test prompts & policies; deploy with observability and safe rollback/fallback. RAG done right: Build retrieval pipelines & vector search (Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector, FAISS/Chroma); handle data prep, chunking, metadata, and IRstyle evals (e.g., NDCG) to maximize signal to noise. Production rigor: Instrument metrics/logs/traces; run A/B experiments; maintain incident playbooks; and implement safety & compliance guardrails. SRE & FinOps for AI: Define SLIs/SLOs (quality/latency/safety/cost), run on call and postmortems, reduce MTTR; meter usage and optimize token/spend. Reusable platform components: Ship SDKs, CI/CD templates, Terraform/IaC modules, evaluation harnesses that accelerate multiple mission team not one-off projects. Operate in real world constraints: Deliver into hybrid, restricted, or air gapped environments with Zero Trust principles and audit ready controls. You'll Thrive Here If you have Built and deployed a production GenAI application (chatbot, copilot, assistant, or enterprise AI). Hands-on with LLMs GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, via APIs or self-hosted. Designed and implemented RAG solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search for enterprise or mission data. Shipped AI applications with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, DSPy, or similar. Strong Python development for building and integrating AI/ML applications. Owned AI solutions through full production life cycle, deployment and operational support. Active U.S. citizenship. Nice to Have Integration with leading cloud AI services or on prem inference stacks Background in LLM evaluation, prompt authoring/testing, A/B experimentation, and LLM Ops. Responsible AI expertise (privacy, security, bias, transparency, human in the loop) and data governance. Experience implementing tool using agents for API integration and external data access. Containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, VMware) and scripting/automation (Linux Bash, PowerShell). Prior work in regulated/secure environments (e.g., ATO, STIGs, Zero Trust) with fast shipping. Familiarity with NVIDIA AI Foundations, OpenAI ChatGPT, and AI assisted dev tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude). Contributions to internal frameworks or opensource; mentorship of engineers. Clear communication with engineers, PMs, and security/compliance stakeholders. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: Acumatica is looking for a Software Developer to join the Vertrax business unit. Vertrax was built to empower midstream and downstream fuel suppliers with cutting-edge ERP and logistics solutions designed to address the complexities of the energy industry. Our mission is to simplify the demands of fuel operations, drive efficiency, and give businesses a genuine competitive edge. Different by design, Vertrax is business technology purpose-built for the fuel industry. Our unified platform brings together two solutions. Vertrax Energy ERP is a commercial-grade, cloud-native back-office system that delivers real-time insights into every operation and automates the order-to-cash workflow. SmartDrops handles dispatch and logistics, including optimized route scheduling, driver performance tracking, and delivery analytics, built directly into Vertrax Energy ERP for seamless, live data communication. Together, they support fuel, propane, and lubricant operations, replacing inefficient legacy systems with a single modern, scalable solution. More than a product, Vertrax is a community of partners, customers, and creators dedicated to helping fuel businesses thrive on their own terms. In 2026, we joined Acumatica as a dedicated business unit, combining our deep industry expertise with the momentum, scale, and platform strength of a cloud ERP leader. Our culture is collaborative and high-energy. We are passionate about our product and mission, guided by our commitment to teamwork, partnership, creativity, agility, and integrity. We turn industry challenges into lasting opportunities and have fostered a culture of loyalty among our employees, our customers, and the fuel businesses we serve. Vertrax offers exceptional professional and financial growth potential. To learn more about the Vertrax mission, visit https://vertrax.com/about/ Job Description We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with strong front-end expertise in React and practical back-end experience with Java and Spring Boot. In this role, you will build responsive, intuitive web applications; integrate user interfaces with scalable services and databases; and collaborate with product, design, quality assurance, and engineering partners to deliver reliable software. The ideal candidate combines sound engineering practices with strong user-experience awareness, analytical problem-solving, and attention to detail. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and deploy responsive, accessible, and visually consistent user interfaces using React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Translate wireframes, mockups, and product requirements into reusable, maintainable front-end components. Develop and maintain back-end APIs and services using Java and Spring Boot. Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs or GraphQL services. Write and optimize SQL queries to support application functionality, performance, and data integrity. Improve application speed, scalability, reliability, and usability through performance analysis and sound engineering practices. Collaborate with product managers, designers, quality assurance professionals, and engineers throughout the software development lifecycle. Write clean, testable, well-documented code and participate in code reviews. Use Git, npm, and related development tools to maintain code quality, version control, and build automation. Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, and contribute to continuous product improvement. Participate in Agile planning, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives. Stay current with modern front-end, back-end, cloud, and user-experience practices. Qualifications Three or more years of professional software development experience, with substantial hands-on front-end development experience. Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Experience with Node.js and npm-based development workflows. Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot, including the ability to implement and maintain straightforward back-end APIs. Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write efficient, well-structured database queries. Experience integrating web applications with RESTful APIs; GraphQL experience is also welcome. Proficiency with Git or a comparable version-control platform. Strong understanding of responsive design, usability, browser compatibility, and front-end performance. Demonstrated problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with strong attention to detail. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. Preferred Qualifications: One or more years of experience working in an Agile software development environment. Experience with DevOps practices, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines. Familiarity with AWS or another cloud platform. Experience with browser debugging, profiling, and performance-testing tools. Knowledge of secure coding practices, API authentication, and scalable application design. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Cargill is a family company providing food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and industrial products that are vital for living. We connect farmers with markets so they can prosper. We connect customers with ingredients so they can make meals people love. And we connect families with daily essentials — from eggs to edible oils, salt to skincare, feed to alternative fuel. Our 160,000 colleagues, operating in 70 countries, make essential products that touch billions of lives each day. Join us and reach your higher purpose at Cargill. This position is in Cargill’s animal nutrition and health business, where we improve animal lives through better nutrition. Our team researches, innovates and creates solutions that deliver healthy results for our customers. Your Role: Connect to meaningful work. Feed the world. Achieve your higher purpose. What if your ideas could nourish the world? As an associate, we transfer your knowledge and skills into profound experiences that positively impact our global community. From food to transportation, your innovative solutions, collaboration and dedication will evolve industries to take on tomorrow's greatest challenges. And that's just the beginning. Because when your skills meet our unrivaled network and breadth of opportunity, your career is without bounds. We enable this commitment by being a proven and trusted technology partner, understanding our customers’ businesses, and bringing significant industry knowledge and investment in software and services solutions to our customers – helping customers to grow their businesses. When you step into the Software Engineer Associate role, you will apply your talents on both digital and transformative initiatives. You will get to collaborate with cross-functional global teams or work directly with customers as a key player in a broad range of opportunities with a bright future. Your work: Develop, test, integrate, maintain, troubleshoot and document software solutions. Ensure code quality and incorporate security practices in newly developed and maintained applications. Collaborate with the team to adopt agile philosophies, participate in agile ceremonies and help to identify improvements. Participate in peer code reviews and learn and adapt to the company's engineering and development practices. Participate in the engineering community by maintaining and sharing relevant technical approaches and modern skills. Partner collaboratively with other teams to deliver digital solutions. jobs.description: Cox Automotive is looking for a senior software engineer that applies the principles of secure software engineering to the design, development, maintenance, testing and evaluation of software and cloud infrastructure. Works cross functionally to understand business requirements, architecture and technology direction, evaluate alternative approaches and ensure software and systems are designed accordingly. Incorporates state-of-the-art concepts and practices to facilitate system functionality, scalability, resilience and security as well as ease-of-use (developer / user experience). Applies agile principles to software development with a focus on delivery of business value, collaboration, continuous improvement and sustainability. Visa Sponsorship: Cox Automotive is unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 4 years' experience in a related field; or a different combination, such as a master's degree and 2 years' experience; a Ph.D. and 1 years' experience in a related field; or 12 years' experience in a related field with no degree. Professional experience designing, building, and maintaining production software in a modern object-oriented language (e.g., C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, TypeScript, Python, C++). Strong command of object-oriented design fundamentals - encapsulation, composition, interface design, SOLID, dependency injection, and common design patterns - with the judgment to know when not to apply them. Experience delivering software in a microservice or service-oriented architecture, including defining service boundaries, versioning APIs, and handling distributed failure modes (timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure). Experience designing and consuming HTTP/REST APIs (or gRPC/GraphQL equivalents), including contract design, backward compatibility, and authentication/authorization patterns. Proficiency with relational databases: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions, and managed schema migrations. Experience with asynchronous and message-driven processing using queues, topics, or event streams. Experience building and operating services in a public cloud environment, including containerized workloads. Demonstrated automated testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, with work delivered through a CI/CD pipeline. Proficiency with Git-based workflows and code review as a routine part of delivery - both giving and receiving substantive feedback. Experience with production support and observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and triaging live incidents. Track record of senior-level ownership: taking ambiguous problems through design, implementation, and release; decomposing work for others; and raising engineering standards on a team. Clear written and verbal communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working in an Agile or iterative delivery model. This role may require participation in a rotating on-call schedule, including support outside of regular business hours. Preferred Qualifications Comfort with AI-assisted development tooling as part of a normal workflow. Hands-on experience with C# and .NET (modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core). Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, including modern component patterns, state management, and component/E2E testing. Production experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL. Experience using Redis for caching, distributed locking, or rate limiting, including cache invalidation strategy. AWS experience, particularly ECS/Fargate, RDS, SQS/SNS, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, and IAM. Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation) and Docker. Familiarity with distributed system patterns such as outbox, saga/compensating transactions, eventual consistency, and idempotent consumers. Demonstrated performance and scalability work: profiling, query optimization, caching strategy, or load testing. Experience with feature flags and progressive delivery (canary releases, dark launches, trunk-based development). Familiarity with static analysis, code quality, and dependency/security scanning tooling (e.g., SonarQube, SAST, SCA). Experience modernizing or retiring legacy systems, including incremental migration approaches such as strangler-fig. Experience integrating third-party vendor APIs, including handling vendor migrations. Multi-tenant SaaS experience, especially entitlements, tiered packaging, or role-based access control. Domain experience in two-sided marketplaces, logistics, transportation, or automotive. Experience with resiliency practices such as game days, chaos exercises, or documented runbooks. Experience mentoring engineers or interns, and participating in hiring and interview loops. USD 101,500.00 - 169,100.00 per year Compensation Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $101,500.00 - $169,100.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. Benefits The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. EOE, including disability/vets

At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world. What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you! Who we are: Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world. Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies. With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow. Job Description The Opportunity: We, at Flywire, are looking for a Software Engineer 2. As a Software Engineer 2, you will be a contributor to our billing and payments product that supports the money movement of hundreds of millions for colleges and universities. This is a full-stack role that requires a blend of technical proficiency and the ability to navigate a variety of client requirements. You will be expected to work closely with our US based software engineering and product teams while maintaining a collaborative presence with other teams across the globe. We are looking for an engineer who balances a pragmatic design approach with a commitment to building quality, secure, and scalable products. Key Responsibilities: Feature Development: Design, build, and maintain high-quality, testable, and maintainable code within our billing and payments system. AI-Leveraged Exploration: Uses AI tools as a force multiplier — for code exploration, test scaffolding, rubber-ducking and assisting in producing production-quality code. Quality & Security: Ensure that security, quality, scaling, and performance are never sacrificed for speed. Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively across engineering and product teams. Collaborative Problem Solving: Participate in solutioning meetings, comfortably debating the pros and cons without ego. Qualifications Here's What We're Looking For: Technical Requirements: Java Proficiency: Professional experience in Java development is a must. Database Knowledge: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL) Core Stack (Nice to Have): Experience with Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Batch and Hibernate. Front-End Skills: Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSP (Java Server Pages). Modern Workflow: You must be comfortable using AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity and writing comprehensive test cases for all new code using JUnit 5 + Mockito + AssertJ. Your Professional Profile: Self-Reliant & Proactive: You are a "figure-it-out" engineer who takes ownership of tasks but knows when to approach leadership with well-formed, insightful questions. Adaptable: You have the aptitude to learn new systems or legacy codebases quickly and can manage your own time effectively to meet deadlines. Global Collaborator: You enjoy working with diverse teams across different time zones and possess outstanding verbal and written communication skills. Qualifications: 3-6 years of professional experience in application development. Proven track record as a Java Developer in a production environment. Experience in FinTech or Higher Education sectors is appreciated. Familiarity with student billing / tuition workflows is a plus. Ability to deliver high-quality code and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment. Additional Information Submit today and get started! We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $110,000-$130,000 plus benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, position level, and location. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and several other factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education and training. Your Talent Acquisition Partner can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. jobs.description: A Better Built World At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc. For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s. That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution. This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started. About The Team And How We Work Building the OS for the built world is no small feat. We’ll need to ship a LOT of high quality code in the coming years, and to do so, we’re building an engineering culture centered around craft, ownership, and collaboration. >25% of our engineers and product managers are ex-founders, and we hire for slope, not intercept. Being a place where you can just build things requires talent density and some unique ways of doing things. A Few Ways We’re Different No rules…rules: Many engineering teams design processes and rules around the lowest common denominator. Not us! We trust brilliant engineers to deliver magical customer outcomes and introduce processes and rules only when necessary. Full-full-stack: Our technology stack (TypeScript everywhere!) and processes are designed to encourage engineers to run their projects end-to-end. This usually involves writing technical blueprints, implementing full-stack solutions, and talking to customers directly to get feedback. Lean and AI-native: AI is turning 10x engineers into 100x engineers. We believe lean, talent-dense, AI-native teams will outship much larger teams with less talent density. Blueprints and building blocks: One of our core Miter values is “build the blueprint”. Writing things down clarifies our thinking and aligns our teams. This also applies to building fundamental building blocks and abstractions that make developers’ lives easier. We feel our customers’ pain and celebrate their success: We encourage engineers to build direct relationships with customers, feel their pain, and celebrate their success. We love fast feedback loops. We’re meritocratic: We value results and hard work. We reward engineers who consistently ship and deliver for customers with increased scope and compensation. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain products/systems that power our core platform. Collaborate with product managers and other engineers to deliver high-quality experiences. Actively participate in blueprinting, code reviews, and technical documentation for your team. What You'll Need 0-1 years of professional software development experience. Strong problem-solving skills. A growth mindset and curiosity to understand business context and user needs. Strong work ethic and reliability when owning tasks and deliverables. A team-oriented attitude with humility and openness to new ideas. Our Tech Stack React + React Native Node/Express MongoDB Render Check Stripe (Issuing, Treasury) Typescript Our Interview Process Recruiter Intro A technical screen where we pair on a real-life problem A (virtual) onsite! Practical coding exercise Miter values with Engineering leader Our Benefits Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages. Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs. 401(k) Retirement Plan: Company-matched contributions to help you plan for your future. Flexible PTO: Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self. Parental Leave: Generous 16-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents. Learning & Development: We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development. Office Extras: Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in-office Mitosaurs. Community: Company-wide and team-specific off-sites per year. Hybrid Vs. Remote Approach We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as hybrid, our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach. Otherwise, for roles listed as remote or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company-wide and team specific off-sites! Join our Talent Community Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? Apply to our Talent Community , and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience! Equal Opportunity Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Use Of Artificial Intelligence In Our Hiring Process Miter uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process to help our recruiting team manage and review applications more efficiently. We want to be transparent about how this works. What the AI does: When you apply to a role at Miter, an AI tool may review your application against the specific qualifications and requirements posted for that job. This tool identifies whether your experience appears to meet, partially meet, or not meet each stated requirement, and it provides supporting evidence from your application for every assessment it makes. What the AI does not do: The AI does not make hiring decisions. It does not reject, advance, or rank candidates on its own, and it does not assign you a numerical score. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team, who makes the final call on whether you move forward. The AI is a tool that helps our team prioritize their time across a high volume of applications. It is not a substitute for human judgment. What information it uses: The tool evaluates the application materials you submit (your resume and any other application content) against role-specific criteria our team has defined. It does not pull information from external sources such as social media or professional networking profiles, and personal identifying information is removed from your materials before any AI review takes place. Human oversight: Our recruiting team periodically reviews how these tools are performing to check for unintended patterns in outcomes, and we retain the ability to override any AI-generated assessment at any time.

We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area. ✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection: Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week. Location This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, with team members expected to work onsite one day per week for in-person collaboration. About the role We’re seeking a Software Engineer (IC1) to join our team and help support and grow Point’s multi-product digital platform. In this role, you’ll work under the guidance of senior engineers and alongside product partners on the Customer Operations pillar , building smaller features within a defined product area that help our Sales and Customer Experience teams deliver faster, smarter, and more personalized experiences for our customers. This is an entry point into production engineering. You’ll learn how our systems fit together, how features move from design review to release, and how emerging technologies—such as AI-assisted workflows—are applied in real production environments under responsible data and privacy guidelines. This role is ideal for an early-career engineer who is eager to learn, receptive to feedback, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and inclined to over-communicate rather than go quiet. Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team! Your responsibilities Build and ship smaller, well-scoped features within an established codebase, with guidance from senior engineers. Write and test code against the acceptance criteria of your assigned tasks, including unit tests for both positive and negative conditions. Submit clear, reviewable PRs; review teammates’ code and use feedback on your own PRs as a key resource for technical growth. Work with senior engineers to design solutions for assigned tasks and discuss the tradeoffs of different approaches. Participate in sprint planning, grooming, retrospectives, and technical design reviews with a view toward learning best practices. Communicate progress, risks, and blockers early and often to your team and cross-functional partners — err on the side of over-communication. Learn how AI- and data-powered components are used in production systems while following responsible data and privacy guidelines. Write clearly in both informal (Slack, email) and formal (Jira tickets, commit messages, PR descriptions) media. Follow team standards for testing, documentation, monitoring, and operational readiness, and make minor refactors to keep the code you touch clean and clear. Estimate your own tasks, seek out mentorship, and work with product managers to understand the business impact of technical decisions. About you Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, including internships or co-op experience, writing object-oriented code in a production, coursework, or open-source setting. Foundational grasp of object-oriented design — classes, interfaces, encapsulation, and inheritance versus composition — in at least one object-oriented language such as TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Java, or C#. Working understanding of data structures and data modeling, and the ability to break a problem into well-named objects, methods, and responsibilities. Some exposure to building or consuming APIs and to working with a relational database. Familiarity with unit testing, including stubbing or mocking dependencies, and a willingness to build that skill quickly. Exposure to customer-facing applications through coursework, internships, side projects, or early professional work. Ability to communicate clearly with teammates and ask questions when product or design requirements are ambiguous. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing quality and speed while learning under guidance. Collaborative team player who actively seeks out feedback and mentorship and acts on it. Nice to have Exposure to common design patterns, or to a statically typed language such as Java, C#, or Kotlin A/B testing frameworks and data-driven experimentation in a Growth or conversion context AI/ML-powered personalization or recommendation feature integration Analytics instrumentation (PostHog, Segment, Amplitude) Coursework, internship, or side-project experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated industry Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role in the San Francisco Bay Area | $138,700 - $153,300 This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. About Prophetic Real estate development is a multi-billion-dollar industry that has run on fragmented data, manual processes, and gut instinct for decades. Prophetic is changing that. We're building the AI-native platform that enables homebuilders, developers, and investors to find, analyze, and act on land opportunities from a single system — powered by proprietary technologies that process billions of data points across all 50 states. We are the market leader in our space, and our customers don't just use the product — they love it. We're not making teams more efficient. We're changing how they operate. Prophetic is scaling fast — demand is outpacing our ability to hire, and we're just getting started. This is a once-in-a-lifetime team: sharp, low ego, deeply collaborative, and obsessed with building the best product in the industry. Come disrupt an industry with us. About The Role The engineering team is scaling to meet demand that is outpacing our ability to ship. You'll build across our core platform products that homebuilders and developers use to find, analyze, and act on land opportunities across all 50 states. You'll report to our CTO, working alongside a team of senior engineers shipping features every two to three weeks. You're expected to use AI tooling daily as a standard part of the engineering workflow. We run automated testing across the platform. We have multiple openings across the platform. You'll own features end-to-end, from database to UI, and ship code that supports customers making million-dollar land acquisition decisions. What You'll Do Build and ship full-stack features across our core platform using modern backend and frontend frameworks. Design and optimize database schemas for geospatial queries across large datasets. Write production-quality code that deploys through our CI/CD pipeline. Collaborate with product, design, and account management to translate customer needs into shipped features. Use AI tooling as part of your daily development workflow — our engineers approach writing code. AI-first.Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and on-call rotation. What You Need 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with Python and TypeScript/React, or similar. Strong experience with relational databases and RESTful API design. Comfort working across the full stack — you can build a backend endpoint and the frontend component that consumes it. Experience shipping features in a production environment with CI/CD pipelines. Comfort with AI development tooling. Strong sense of product ownership. Familiarity with a fast-paced startup environment. Nice To Have Experience with geospatial data (parcel data, map layers, or simiar). Experience with major cloud platforms.Background in proptech, real estate, or construction technology. Why Prophetic The team. Wide expertise, sharp, low ego, and genuinely fun to work with. We have each other's backs and we celebrate wins together. Real ownership and impact from day one. Our customers make million-dollar decisions on our platform. Your work matters immediately. AI-native product and AI-native workflows. Every team — engineering, sales, operations — runs on AI tooling daily. Founder-led transparency. Leadership shares the financials, the strategy, and the hard calls with the whole team. High growth, high demand. The product works, customers love it, and we are hiring to keep up. No shortage of opportunity here. Flexibility. Remote, hybrid, or in-office with a great Portland, OR headquarters. Self-starters who thrive in ambiguity. We're a startup. We speak plainly, flag problems early, and share what's actually going on. Precision — Sign your name to it. Our customers make million-dollar decisions on our data. We get the details right. This wasn't the end goal, it was how we deeply understood the complexity needed to build software that actually works in regulated industries. The results speak for themselves. We've transformed mortgage servicing from a 0% margin business into 60%+ margins while dramatically improving customer experience. Major enterprise contracts are now deploying across the industry. ValonOS is our unified platform that makes every process structured and programmable and it is perfectly positioned for the AI era. When everything flows through one system with rich data, AI agents don't just automate tasks, they continuously improve entire operations. Mortgage servicing is just the beginning of our vision to transform regulated industries and beyond. jobs.title: Software engineer, full-stack
jobs.description: About Watershed Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! The role We are looking for a team member who is excited to do everything involved in shipping great products, including hands-on engineering, talking with customers, and mastering the climate domain. Your past experience should include a track record of building things that users love. Watershed’s technical stack is the web frontend that our customers use, together with a backend of climate data, climate models, and plug-ins to various financial systems. We build new products in a customer-first way so you’ll be working quite a bit in React, TypeScript, CSS, Node.js, etc. There’s no need to be a prior expert in our stack — it’s more important that you’re good at picking up technologies quickly. Some traits that are important to our company culture: customer-obsessed, outcome-oriented, and inclusive. And we’re looking for owners, so we hope you’ll help us evolve this list. What you could work on: Build new interactive data visualizations to help climate leads understand their company's emissions. Build APIs to unify carbon data access for customers and other engineers. Build tools that help financial institutions measure and report emissions across their portfolio companies. Build tools for customers to effectively ingest and interpret business data. You will: Ship code to production on day one Collaborate with product, design, climate science, and data science to build and iterate on software that helps our customers understand their climate data You might be a fit if you: Have 4+ years of software engineering industry experience, preferably in Node.js web development or data pipelines Have experience building scalable software starting from user needs Are excited to join a startup and are ready to help evolve a growing engineering team Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.description: 🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot! Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. 💻 Role We are looking for intellectually curious, highly motivated individuals to join us post grad in 2027. The most important skills you’ll need to have are making sound product decisions and shipping high-quality products fast. We look for engineers with great product instincts who can own whole projects from start to finish. Job Duties The engineering team operates with a high level of autonomy so we need to hire people we can trust. Your ability to make good trade-offs and exercise good judgment is essential to us. Some job duties include: Building new features for users in our live-streams Implementing growth tactics and strategies to scale our buyer and seller flows Building systems at scale that help us deliver a high trust marketplace experience Writing product or system development code Designing, implementing, and operating our most critical and scalable services Carefully evaluating the technical tradeoffs of every decision Supporting features at every phase, from design through implementation and launch Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues, network, or service operations and quality. We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of one of our following hubs; Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, or Seattle 👋 You People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Engineer you should have some industry software engineering experience, plus: Graduated with a CS or Software Engineering degree by Summer 2027 Problem solver and out-of-the-box thinker Willing to take risks and build product and systems for 1M+ users Capable of building scalable systems Excellent product instincts. You first think about users rather than the best technical solution You are known for shipping products and features lightning-fast Ability to pick up on new technologies very quickly Open to relocation to Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, or Seattle 🎁 Benefits Generous Holiday and Time off Policy Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision Work From Home Support Home office setup allowance Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet Care benefits Monthly allowance for wellness Annual allowance towards Childcare Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally Monthly allowance to dogfood the app All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). Parental Leave 16 weeks of paid parental leave + one month gradual return to work *company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: At Zotec Partners, our People make it happen. Transforming the healthcare industry isn’t easy. But when you build a team like the one we have, that goal can become a reality. Our accomplishments can’t happen without our extraordinary people – the men and women across the country who make up our diverse Zotec family and help make this company a best place to work. Over 25 years ago, we started Zotec with a clear vision, to partner with physicians to simplify the business of healthcare. Today we are more than 900 employees strong and we continue to use our incredible talent and energy to bring that vision to life. We are a team of Innovators, Collaborators and Doers. We’re seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join us. As a Senior ML Engineer at Zotec, you will build and extend the machine learning and AI systems that give our teams direct, governed access to data and AI tooling. You will design and ship models, build the infrastructure and integrations that connect large language models to real Zotec data, and help define how AI systems reason over that data safely and accurately. This role is perfect if you’re passionate about applied ML, AI tooling, and turning complex data into systems the business can actually use. We’re seeking ML engineering professionals with: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a STEM field; Master's degree preferred 3-5 years delivering ML solutions at scale Proficiency in: Python Machine learning model development, training, and evaluation Working with structured and unstructured data at scale System design for data and ML pipelines Familiarity with: AWS, including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Redshift Claude and other large language models Ontology, knowledge graphs, or structured data modeling DevOps practices, such as CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (IaC) Experience in: Building and maintaining tools and integrations that connect large language models to real data sources Deploying and monitoring ML models in production on AWS Applying knowledge representation (ontologies, taxonomies, or graphs) to improve retrieval or reasoning Instrumenting models and pipelines for observability and performance monitoring Who You Are: Can communicate clearly and effectively with cross-functional teams, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and other engineers Enjoy balancing technical depth with practical problem-solving, knowing when to prioritize performance, scalability, or accuracy Are committed to writing clean, maintainable code and mentoring others through code reviews, documentation, and collaboration Enjoy collaborating closely with a supportive team to tackle complex technical challenges from start to finish Understand the importance of quality standards, processes, compliance and security as it relates to the healthcare industry and have general knowledge of standards such as HIPAA or PCI What You’ll Do: Design, develop, and maintain the ML models and data integrations that power our AI-driven products and internal tools Connect large language models to real data by building and maintaining the tools and integrations that let AI systems query and reason over Zotec’s data accurately and safely Own the ML lifecycle from problem framing and data preparation through model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring Architect for AWS, designing scalable, cost-aware ML infrastructure using services like SageMaker, Bedrock, and Lambda Bring structure to data by applying ontology, taxonomy, or knowledge-graph thinking where it improves retrieval, reasoning, or data quality for AI systems Other Ways You Can Contribute: Help us continue to expand our usage of LLM application patterns with your experience in retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and evaluation frameworks Utilize your experience with knowledge graphs and semantic data modeling to help us further improve data retrieval and reasoning Follow the appropriate development methodologies including Scrum and Kanban How We Focus on Your Wellbeing: Paid time off (PTO) to balance a fulfilling work and personal life Health, dental and vision insurance Company paid life insurance, AD&D, and disability Money for your 401k Volunteerism support and charitable gift matching through the Zotec Effect program Tailored learning and professional development opportunities to help you grow your career in ways that matter to you
